requirement:
修复订单管理、用户管理和寄存服务的线上 hotfix。
线上出现订单状态不同步、用户信息丢失和寄存价格计算错误的问题。
需要紧急修复相关服务的数据处理逻辑。

details.name: ts-consign-price-service
details.rationale: Directly responsible for consign price calculation, so it must be fixed for the pricing error.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order status synchronization issues likely involve the core order service that ts-admin-order-service manages.

details.name: ts-consign-service
details.rationale: Consignment service handles consign price calculations, which are reported as incorrect.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: User information loss is directly related to user management, and this service is the admin counterpart for user operations.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and may share data processing logic with ts-admin-order-service, affecting order status sync.

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: Core user data service that ts-admin-user-service interacts with; user info loss likely originates here.

details.name: ts-admin-basic-info-service
details.rationale: May provide basic info used by order/user/consign services, but less directly related to the reported issues.

details.name: ts-admin-route-service
details.rationale: Route admin service could be tangentially involved if order status depends on route data, but not a primary suspect.

details.name: ts-admin-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel admin service may interact with orders but is less likely to be affected by these specific hotfixes.
